name: later-gator
description: Private, single-user AI bookmark manager on Cloudflare

scripts.check: npm run types:check && npm run lint && npm run test

DB.description: Stores the authoritative Later Gator bookmark library and application state.

THUMBNAILS.description: Stores private optimized bookmark preview bytes outside the D1 database.

IMAGES.description: Creates uncropped, aspect-preserving WebP bookmark previews before private Workers KV storage.

AI.description: Runs organization inference when Cloudflare Workers AI is selected.

BACKGROUND_QUEUE.description: Carries opaque job IDs only and invokes one sequential background job at a time.

BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD.description: Later Gator password. Use 16 or more characters when possible (10-character compatibility minimum); this field is intentionally blank by default.
